content: Minimal Supabase IoT backend shape: Device -> HTTPS -> Supabase (Postgres for content metadata/device registry, Storage for binary files like photos/audio/OTA images, Auth or a custom per-device API-key/RLS policy for device identity, optional Edge Functions for custom logic like signed-URL issuance or OTA manifest generation). Row-Level-Security policies scope each device's queries to its own rows.
